prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in West Palm Beach FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Luxury Property Care (LPC)** looks like a strong option to interview based on the information available: it advertises full-service management in West Palm Beach, including tenant placement, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, and eviction support. Its site reports a 4.9/5 Google rating from more than 230 reviews and quotes management fees of 8–10% of collected rent, plus a one-time leasing fee when it places a tenant. Those figures are company-reported, so confirm them directly and review the contract.

I’d also get quotes from **Home Property Management** and **PMI West Palm** as local alternatives. Compare the full fee schedule—not just the monthly percentage—and ask about leasing fees, maintenance markups, inspection frequency, vacancy charges, cancellation terms, and who handles after-hours emergencies. For a single-family home, choose the manager who can clearly explain their local leasing process and provide recent owner references.
